meta.title: MapleStory Idle RPG (메이플 키우기) jobs & skills — extracted from mapleidleindex.com mirror of client 1.18.0 tables

sourceFiles.role: all job/skill/mastery/projectile tables, factor curves, enhance rule
Korean names: MAPLE_SKILL_NAMES (skills), MAPLE_JOB_NAMES (jobs), MAPLE_MASTERY_NAMES (mastery nodes)
Korean in-game description templates + param scaling
site skill-level / coefficient / mastery engine (logic + job names)

conventions: Operations arrays are 1-based: Operations[0] is null in the source.
Values in "M" units: 1000 = 100%. Displayed percent = value / 10 (scale.displayedPercentDivisor).
Time in ms, distance in mm (RectAreaMm/MaxRangeMm = [front, back, up, down] per skill-hitbox-model.mjs shapeBounds).
Fields prefixed "derived" are computed by the documented formula or by the site engine; everything else is copied verbatim.

jobSteps.source: skill-engine.js STEP_UNLOCK_LEVELS (site constant, also skills-page.js STEP_START)

skillLevel.formula: skillLevel = DisableSkillLevel ? 1 : (JobStep in 1..4 ? max(1, 1 + enhance[JobStep] + allSkill + stepBonus[JobStep]) : 1)
skillLevel.enhanceFormula: enhance[step] = max(0, min(cap[step], trunc((characterLevel - levelOffset[step]) * multiplier[step])))
skillLevel.linkedSkills: A skill with FollowLevelIndex uses the level of the hero row it follows; a skill with neither a hero row nor FollowLevelIndex (most mastery programs) is Lv.1.
skillLevel.overrideRange: site accepts per-skill override 1..1000; factor curves hold levels 1..1000
skillLevel.note: assumedFullySpentFormula is the site assumption that all enhancement points are spent (startLevel 11, 3 points per level).

levelScaling.formula: for each pair (valueIndex, curveId) in operation.ValueLevelFactors: Values[valueIndex] = trunc(Values[valueIndex] * factorCurves[curveId][skillLevel] / 1000)
levelScaling.descriptionFormula: skill-descriptions.js: value + trunc(value * (factor - 1000) / 1000), factor = curve[min(level, 1000)]; then Div n => trunc(value/n*10)/10
levelScaling.formulaValues: Non-numeric Values (expressions starting with $ or #) are evaluated at runtime first; the pending curve is then applied to the evaluated number (scaleEvaluatedValue).

damageOperation.GetDamageR: Values = [ratioM, damageFlag, hitCount]; MaxHitCount = max targets per hit; RectAreaMm/RadiusMm = hit area; ModStats = per-hit extra stats (AttackPowerToBoss / AttackPowerExcludeBoss in M units).
damageOperation.GetDotR: damage over time: Values = [ratioM per tick, flag, ticks]; the site excludes DoT from per-use coefficients.
damageOperation.perUseCoefficient: oneHitPercent = ratioM_scaled / 10 * (1 + GiveDamagePower1_M/1000) * (1 + Power2_M/1000) * (1 + Power3_M/1000) * Π(1 + pipelineFinalDamage_M/1000); total = oneHitPercent * hitCount * repeatCount; then × Π(1 + ModSkillStat FinalDamage_M/1000) per independent passive owner.

masteryNumericMerge.formula: value = trunc(setValue * (1000 + Σ ratioM) / 1000) + Σ add; setValue = last SetSkill value or the level-scaled base; ModSkillR = ratio, ModSkill = add, SetSkill = set.
masteryNumericMerge.unlock: A mastery node is active when characterLevel >= RequireCreatureLevel (site assumes every unlocked node is learned; RequireMasteryIndex/CostData/LearnedDelaySeconds are the in-game learning chain).

staticPeakStateMax.source: skill-engine.js STATIC_PEAK_STATE_MAX (fallback when runtime state table absent)

rules.flashSlashMacro: #FlashSlash(x): engine uses x (unbuffed) or x*1.5 (peak, ComboAttack > 2) — skill-engine.js resolveSupportedDamageExpression
rules.cosmicShowerMacro: #CosmicShower(a;b): first hit on fresh target = a*(SM_CosmicShower_Damaged max+1)*b/1000

basicAttackCadence.applicability: skill must have ReplaceBaseAttack flag, no IgnoreSkillSpeed, CoolTimeMs 0/absent, no ticking GetDamage, and only one-shot projectiles

rules.siteCategory: PassiveSkill => passive; ActiveSkill with tag "attack" => active; other ActiveSkill => buff (skills-page.js skillCategory)
rules.damagePerUse: calcv4 inline script: damage = scenarioDamage(profile, target, route) * totalPercent/100 per line; route basic => ×(1+basicDamage%), skill => ×(1+skillDamage%); line-local AttackPowerToBoss/ExcludeBoss added to boss/normal damage%.
